Committee: Ways and Means General Fund
Sponsor: Lovvorn
Analyst: Daniel Davenport
Date: 02/14/2022
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 329 as introduced removes the time limitations for Tier I firefighters, law enforcement officers, and correctional officers covered under the Employees Retirement System or the Teachers Retirement System to purchase eligible service prior to January 1, 2001.
The actuary for the Retirement Systems of Alabama (RSA) is unable to provide a quantifiable estimate of the potential increase in obligations of the systems; however, RSA indicated the inpact is projected to be minimal, as the provisions of the bill would apply to a limited group of members.
Steve Clouse, Chair
Ways and Means General Fund

FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 329 as passed the House of Representatives removes the time limitations for Tier I firefighters, law enforcement officers, and correctional officers covered under the Employees Retirement System or the Teachers Retirement System to purchase eligible service credit prior to January 1, 2003.
The actuary for the Retirement Systems of Alabama (RSA) is unable to provide a quantifiable estimate of the potential increase in obligations of the systems; however, RSA indicated the impact is projected to be minimal, as the provisions of the bill would apply to a limited group of members.
